key.name: week-bar-visibility
key.description: When to display the secondary 7-day usage bar in the panel: "auto" shows it only when 7-day usage is at or above 50%, "show" always displays it, "hide" hides it permanently.

key.name: user-agent
key.description: Cloudflare ties cf_clearance to the browser that earned it. If requests fail with HTTP 403 right after pasting a fresh cookie, set this to that browser's navigator.userAgent. Empty uses the built-in default.
